name: Spiritual Breakthrough
overview: Scripture reveals that spiritual breakthrough is a divine intervention where God delivers His people from danger and opposition, as seen in Psalms 91:3 and Isaiah 54:17. It involves God making a new way even in the most barren circumstances, providing comfort and restoration (Isaiah 40:1; 43:19). Believers are called to maintain focused faith and boldly confront sin and adversity, trusting in God's protection and righteousness to overcome every challenge (Proverbs 4:25; Isaiah 58:1).
